note: RO-IND-1 is PROPOSED, not adopted: it marks a candidate say-do gap on the page and in the item's say_do block, and moves no tier (feed.rule() returns routine for every item; check recomputes it). It stays a proposal until it is adopted, changed or dropped. No warning problem, so no item carries an indicator_id.

indicators.text: An official statement claims calm (a ceasefire, a denial, an assurance) while other TIC programs see unusual activity in the countries it names.
indicators.rule: PROPOSED 25 Nov 2026, not adopted: a statement whose claim words include deescalation, denial or assurance, paired with anomaly or warning items from at least 2 independence groups (other TIC programs, not stale) that share a country it names and whose data_as_of is within 72 hours of it. Shown as a candidate say-do gap; tier stays routine.

indicators.text: An official statement warns of a response while other TIC programs see unusual activity in the countries it names.
indicators.rule: Information only (readout-0.1): a statement whose claim words include threat, paired with any non-stale anomaly or warning item that shares a country it names within 72 hours. Shown as activity near a threat; no tier, no adoption needed because it marks nothing.
